CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust, CardKeyword.Retain }` (Luminesce.cs:17-21) == both class attributes. Retain as a CANONICAL keyword rather than an upgrade-added one, so no downgrade-rebuild hazard -- contrast card/gold_axe, which gains Retain on upgrade and must re-seed it.

ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Token, TargetType.Self)` (Luminesce.cs:23-26) == cost 0 / SKILL / TOKEN / SELF. TOKEN rarity keeps it out of every reward and generation pool on both sides; it exists only because Radiant Pearl generates it on turn 1.

OnPlay.rationale: `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(DynamicVars.Energy.BaseValue, Owner)` (Luminesce.cs:31) == `EnergyCmd.gain(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._energy)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (30) and the energy hover tip (15).
